records.subject: You're in -- let's get North Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero customer replies to three Wrenfield emails (email:00cb15aa, email:0c78ca95, email:93e94867), no tickets, no project, no invites. Team plan active suggests intent, but total silence through day 6 with all three stall reasons open makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

I haven't heard back, so I'll keep this short. North Ventures is set up on Wrenfield, but the first project hasn't been created yet. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the quickest way to see whether Wrenfield fits how your team works. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
